artefacts.reason: The action-by-action ledger the campaign roll-up is computed from -- the frames and model calls that were actually paid for, and not derivable from anything else in the repository (the tracked ledger.jsonl is a different, shorter record, 560 lines against these 754-1347). battery pins its sha256 too.
